relationships.subject: NSAIDs
relationships.evidence_quote: NSAIDs inhibit the production of prostaglandins and, thus, can lessen the peripheral and central sensory hypersensitivity that occurs with nerve injury-associated inflammation.

key_findings: Review of fibromyalgia pathophysiology (central sensitization, reduced insular GABA, elevated glutamate, miRNA changes) and limited efficacy of current drugs.
Nutraceuticals/polyphenols proposed as novel therapies for fibromyalgia pain.
